name: The Asking Blade (Vấn Phong)
lore: A plain hunter's sword with a notch filed in the guard for every cave its owner has searched. There are 412 notches. Tiêu Vấn Phong had it made in Hòe Âm in 1162 and has never named it; the hall calls it the Asking Blade.
build_use: Crit and pierce for the Asking Canon's marks.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Evening Sword (Mộ Kiếm)
lore: The sword Sài Mộ Kiếm lost with in 1130 at Tống Khách Thị, against Tư Không Hạc Niên. The sage handed it back to him after the duel without a word, which Sài has found harder to bear than losing.
build_use: A duelist's sword: crit damage, speed, and a reward for being struck first.

name: Hunter's Map Coat (Liệp Đồ Bào)
lore: A deer-hide coat with every cave of the southern massif inked on its lining, each one crossed out but one.
build_use: Health and sure hits for the long search.
